statement: A few hamsters debugged every server in the data center. Every hamster that debugged every server supervised some technician. Each technician supervised by such a hamster received a security clearance.

Not every goldfish failed to conduct every audit at the bank. All goldfish that conducted every audit trained some junior analyst. Every junior analyst trained by such a goldfish passed the licensing exam.
Several pigeons designed every bridge in the city. Every pigeon that designed every bridge mentored some apprentice. Each apprentice mentored by such a pigeon submitted a portfolio.
More than one teapot audited every satellite link in the observatory. Any teapot that audited every link trained some technician. Every technician trained by such a teapot received a clearance badge.
A few kittens managed every warehouse in the district. All kittens that managed every warehouse supervised some clerk. Every clerk supervised by such a kitten filed a quarterly report.

No rock ever managed to teach every seminar in the philosophy department. Any rock that did teach every seminar advised some doctoral student. Every doctoral student advised by such a rock published a paper.
Several butterflies audited every account at the firm. All butterflies that audited every account mentored some trainee. Every trainee mentored by such a butterfly earned a certificate.

Exactly one mushroom directed every clinical trial at the hospital. Every mushroom that directed every trial supervised some research assistant. Every research assistant supervised by such a mushroom co-authored a paper.

A few snails inspected every nuclear reactor in the country. All snails that inspected every reactor trained some safety officer. Every safety officer trained by such a snail filed an incident report.

Some mushrooms directed every clinical trial at the hospital. Every mushroom that directed every trial supervised some research assistant. Each research assistant supervised by such a mushroom co-authored a paper.
Several pencils managed every construction project in the city. All pencils that managed every project hired some subcontractor. Every subcontractor hired by such a pencil submitted a final invoice.

Not every robot failed to inspect every launch pad at the spaceport. Every robot that inspected every launch pad trained some safety marshal. Every safety marshal trained by such a robot filed a compliance notice.
